plan.title: [framework-gap] Extend feedback filing to comment on open issues and account for closed issues

narratives.Description: [framework-gap] Extend feedback filing to comment on open issues and account for closed issues
narratives.Overview:
This Recut is self-contained. Predecessor Bound-remedy limbs do not carry unless restated below.

1. **Match shape (number-required).** `DuplicateMatch` is `{ number, state, url, title }` from the REST list row. Do not parse `number` from `html_url`. A row lacking a usable numeric `number` is not a usable match: fail closed with a search-incomplete / malformed-match note and never fall through to `restCreateIssue`.

2. **Open inventory pass.** Use existing `restIssueListOpenInventory` (#3752) for the open pass — complete inventory via `gh api --paginate --slurp`, pulls excluded, fail-closed on non-zero / non-JSON / non-array / `OPEN_INVENTORY_MAX_ISSUES` cap. No newest-100 open window. Fail-closed on open-inventory failure: do not create.

3. **Closed walk window + tokens (Recut-2).** Add a closed-issue sibling of `restWalkClosedPullsUpdatedDesc` return shape with outcome tokens `window-exhausted` | `list-exhausted` | `cap` | `error` (complete vs incomplete named), `sort=updated&direction=desc`, shared raw-row budget defaulting to `REST_SHARED_ROW_BUDGET`. Primary closed search window is a **retained closed-issue count** with named default `FEEDBACK_CLOSED_DEDUP_WINDOW = 500` (builder may expose override later; Bound pins the default). Stop when retained closed issues reach that count, or when the list ends, or when the raw-row budget hits `cap`, or on `error`. **Exclude pull rows** from title matching and from the retained-issue count (PR rows may still consume raw budget). Title-equality decision rule unchanged. Prefer an open match over a closed match when both exist (open precedence makes `--on-closed` inert).

4. **Closed no-hit disposition table (Recut-2).** Map every no-hit outcome explicitly:
   - `window-exhausted` (retained-count hit, no title match) → allow `filed` create with incomplete-search note.
   - `list-exhausted` (full closed list walked, no match) → allow `filed` create; complete-search (no incomplete warning required).
   - `cap` (raw-row budget exhausted before window/list end, no match) → allow `filed` create with incomplete-search note that names `cap` as the stop reason (same availability posture as window-exhausted; do not conflate with time/count window exhaustion; do not fail-closed — that bricks large upstreams).
   - `error` (network / non-JSON / malformed) → fail closed; do not create.
   Every incomplete note MUST report `inspectedIssueCount` (retained closed issues actually examined), `stopReason` (`window-exhausted` | `cap`), and the boundary (default window size or budget). Fail-closed remains for open-inventory failure and for `error` / malformed-match. Do not use truncation-always-fail-closed on the closed pass.

5. **Open-match comment path (P1).** Without `--confirm`: surface open-match URL + proposed evidence-comment body; non-write outcome (`draft` or named preview); never create. With `--confirm` and open match: `restPostComment` with structured evidence body; print issue URL + comment URL; never `restCreateIssue`. New outcome `commented-open-duplicate` with `exitCode: 0` and additive `commentUrl` / `comment_url`. **Retire `blocked-duplicate`** from `FeedbackFileOutcome` (no surviving producer under this Bound); rewrite the live test that asserts confirm+open-match → `blocked-duplicate` exit 1.

6. **Comment body provenance.** Do not reuse `buildFrameworkGapBody` unchanged for comments — its footer says the issue was filed. Use a comment-body variant (or parameterized footer) that cites evidence-append via `feedback:file`, not a filing.

7. **Mutation gate shared by every write.** Before any `restPostComment` / `restCreateIssue`: refuse when `!confirm`, `dryRun`, `offline` (`DEFT_NO_NETWORK=1`), maintainer-repo skip, or upstreamPrompt denial. `--dry-run --confirm` + open match → zero mutation seam calls (pin a test).

8. **Closed-match disposition via argv (P3) — no interactive prompt; no consumer reopen.** Closed title match with no disposition → `blocked-closed-duplicate` exit 1 printing closed match URL + re-run forms. Normative flag: `--on-closed=comment|create-anyway`, also accept space form `--on-closed comment|create-anyway` (parity with existing argv). `--on-closed=bogus` → `error-bad-args` exit 2. `comment`: `restPostComment` on the closed issue; do not reopen. `create-anyway`: `restCreateIssue` body carries `Related: closed #<n>` (still requires `--confirm`). Drop consumer reopen+comment (privileged triage write; conflicts with `#3713` consumer-evidence posture).

9. **Preserve.** Maintainer-repo skip; `valueFeedback.upstreamPrompt`; `--confirm`; `DEFT_NO_NETWORK` dedup-skip note; `#3713` BLOCKER title token without consumer `adoption-blocker` label writes.

10. **Skill co-edit via pack source.** Edit `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json` then `task packs:render`. Update Phase 2/3 + Anti-Patterns for open-match confirm→comment (exit 0 path; not "STOP on blocked-duplicate") and closed `--on-closed` before any write. Phase 3 confirm template must retain `--notes` / blocker evidence flags so the posted comment carries the reviewed payload.

11. **Tests (Recut-2).** Open-inventory finds open match regardless of closed-heavy neighbors; open-inventory fail → no create; closed `window-exhausted` without match → create with incomplete note naming inspected count + stopReason; closed `list-exhausted` without match → create without incomplete warning; closed `cap` before window end with PR-heavy pages → create with incomplete note naming `cap` (not conflated with window-exhausted); `--dry-run --confirm` open-match → zero mutations; confirm+open → `commented-open-duplicate` exit 0 + commentUrl (rewrites old blocked-duplicate pin); closed missing disposition → `blocked-closed-duplicate` no write; `--on-closed=comment` posts no reopen; `--on-closed=create-anyway` creates with Related; malformed row without number → no create; `--on-closed=bogus` → error-bad-args; pull rows excluded from title match and retained count.

12. **P2 coverage bound (Recut-2).** Acceptance for P2 is: detect and disposition closed title matches inside the declared search window; disclose incomplete historical coverage via the note before/when creating on `window-exhausted` or `cap`. Do not claim global elimination of all closed-title duplicates outside the window.

13. **Out of Bound.** `#5424` cite-only. Windows multi-word argv leftover optional. Search-API / body-similarity ranking rejected. Auto-comment without `--confirm` rejected. Silent create on closed match rejected. Hand-edit rendered SKILL.md rejected. Exhaustive closed-history search rejected. Truncation-always-fail-closed on closed pass rejected.
